rounds.response: Escalate to Export Controls/Legal for a formal licensing and end‑use review — do not approve shipment yet. Rationale: these are Tier 2 high‑performance GPU servers to a Category B (Delta) destination, and our policy requires escalation for advanced computing to Category B; the customer’s work for “public sector clients” and the lack of granular end‑use/end‑user detail increase risk of government/defense or sensitive downstream use. Request from the sales lead (before any approval): (1) a detailed end‑use statement and architecture showing how/where the servers will be used, (2) a list of the public‑sector clients/contracts to be served and any government customers, (3) corporate ownership/beneficial‑owner documentation, and (4) an export‑control attestation prohibiting military use or reexport without prior approval; meanwhile perform denied‑party screening and hold shipment pending legal clearance.
